## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the user-visible problem and final behavior.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Separate replay from live evaluation.

## Compatibility and evidence

Describe CLI, format, dependency, or evaluation changes and any new data's rights.

## Checklist

- [ ] Relevant regression tests pass.
- [ ] Ruff and the coverage gate pass.
- [ ] Source validation and honest failure outcomes are preserved.
- [ ] No private records, credentials, or model weights are included.
- [ ] Relevant docs and changelog are updated.
- [ ] Model-quality claims identify supporting evaluation evidence.
